mapper.select: select id, group_id, user_id, dept_id, member_role, status, join_time, leave_time, create_by, create_time, update_time from biz_research_group_member where group_id = #{groupId} order by case member_role when 'LEADER' then 0 when 'CORE' then 1 when 'MEMBER' then 2 else 3 end, id
mapper.insert: insert into biz_research_group_member (group_id, user_id, dept_id, member_role, status, join_time, leave_time, create_by, create_time) values (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{memberRole}, #{status}, ifnull(#{joinTime}, sysdate()), #{leaveTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update biz_research_group_member set user_id = #{userId}, dept_id = #{deptId}, member_role = #{memberRole}, status = #{status}, join_time = #{joinTime}, leave_time = #{leaveTime}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.delete: delete from biz_research_group_member where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId}
